subject: The 2AM feeding trick that saved 15% weight
preview_text: I found a hidden setting in PupShape that stops overfeeding without measuring cups. 110 dogs already use it.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, I saw my dog Max eyeing the treat jar at 2AM, and I realized something that changed everything. Most dog parents—myself included—are accidentally overfeeding by 20-30% because we rely on visual guesses. That one extra scoop or two treats adds up to obesity faster than you think.

Here's the hack: in PupShape, there's a feature most people miss—the 'Treat Budget' inside the calorie calculator. Instead of guessing how many biscuits are safe, you set a daily limit that syncs with your dog's custom meal plan. It automatically subtracts treats from their total calories, so you never have to do math or feel guilty. One user told me his dog dropped 12% body weight in 5 weeks just by using this.

This is the same trick Premium users pay for, but it's already in your app. Open PupShape, go to the 'Treat Budget' section under Calorie Tracker, and set a number that works for your dog's breed and age. It takes 30 seconds, and you'll see the difference in their energy and waistline within days.

Try this now: Open PupShape and set your Treat Budget. P.S. Most dogs need no more than 10% of their daily calories from treats—this feature fixes that automatically. Your dog will thank you with a longer, happier life.
